task.title: Let users delete their account from settings
acceptanceCriteria: A "Delete account" button appears in settings
The user's data is removed according to the retention policy

reason: The retention policy does not say whether invoices must be kept after an account is deleted. Guessing could break a legal obligation.
questionForHuman: When a user deletes their account, should their invoices be kept for 7 years or deleted with everything else?
